parts.name: Translation Panel (Right Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right sliding glass panel of the window, framed with aluminum for structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the window to open or close by sliding horizontally along the track, providing ventilation and access.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally along the track within the base frame.

parts.name: Translation Panel (Left Sliding Pane)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left sliding glass panel of the window, framed with aluminum for durability and smooth movement.
parts.Functional_description: It can slide horizontally to overlap with the right panel, enabling partial opening of the window.
parts.Movement_description: It moves horizontally in the opposite direction of the right panel along the same track.

parts.name: Base Body (Window Frame)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the window that holds the sliding panels in place.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, alignment, and support for the sliding panels, ensuring smooth operation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the fixed base for the sliding components.
